adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.purpose: Read the memberships of the selected organization. This directory does not show login or contact details and offers no account changes.

sections.label: Membership status
sections.body: Filter memberships by their own status. Account status and membership validity are separate facts.

sections.label: Pages
sections.body: Next and Previous show bounded pages of memberships in this organization only.

adminUser.title: Membership detail
adminUser.purpose: Read one organization's membership and the roles assigned to it.

sections.label: Assigned roles
sections.body: A role may start in the future or have expired. Assignment alone does not prove that access is currently effective. Scope names do not reveal other organizations or people.
